messages.subject: knit2html in a Shiny app
parts:
Hello,

 I have a RMarkdown file starting like that : ![id](logo.png)

When running knit2html() in R, the html output is nice, as expected. But when I run knit2html() from my Shiny app, the html is nice except that the png logo does not appear. The file logo.png is in the same folder as the Rmd file.

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: knit2html in a Shiny app
parts: I think all paths in a Shiny app are in reference to a folder named www. So if you save logo.png as www/logo.png, then you can access it in your app as logo.png.

parts:
Yep.

ui.R
shinyUI(basicPage(
  
  downloadButton("downloadHTML", label = "Get html file")
  
))

server.R
library(knitr)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {

  output$downloadHTML <- downloadHandler(
    filename = "output.html",
    content = function(file) {
      knit2html("Rmd.Rmd", output="tmp/output.html", encoding="UTF-8")
      file.copy("tmp/output.html",file)
    }
  )
 
})

messages.subject: Re: knit2html in a Shiny app
parts:
Do not write the output file to another directory; this will confuse
knitr when your output contains images. Normally you should not use
the 'output' argument at all -- knit2html() will return the output
path to you:

out = knit2html("Rmd.Rmd", encoding="UTF-8")
file.copy(out, file)

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: knit2html in a Shiny app
parts:
The input file can be under a different directory; the output is
strongly recommended to be under the current working directory. So you
can do something like

input = normalizePath('foo.Rmd') # full path
owd = setwd(tempdir()); on.exit(setwd(owd))
out = knit2html(input, output = tempfile(, '.'))

file.copy(out, file)

Regards,
Yihui

messages.subject: Re: knit2html in a Shiny app
parts:
Thus, finally, to save output.html before the downloading, I do this:

server.R
require(knitr)

# set an output directory with writing permission
OUTDIR <- "~/tmp/" # for Linux: "/tmp/"

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {

   generateReport <- observe({
     if(input$gobutton==0) return(NULL)
input = normalizePath('Rmd.Rmd')
img = normalizePath('img.png')

owd = setwd(OUTDIR); on.exit(setwd(owd)) 
     file.copy(img, "img.png") # first copy the image file in OUTDIR
     knit2html(input, output = paste0(".\\","output.html")) 
   })

output$downloadHTML <- downloadHandler(
    filename = "output.html",
    content = function(file) {

file.copy(paste0(OUTDIR,"output.html"), file) 
    }
  )
  
})

ui.R
shinyUI(basicPage(

  actionButton("gobutton", "Generate report"),
  conditionalPanel(condition = 'input.gobutton != 0',

downloadButton("downloadHTML", label = "Get html file")
  )
))
